source_refs.note: 1- Heroin: a main subheading of 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 48-48.

blocks.text: It is a highly addictive opioid drug that is derived from the opium poppy plant. It is injected, smoked, or snorted. It produces false senses of euphoria (intense excitement and happiness) and relaxation. Its use quickly leads to dependence and addiction. It has a range of negative physical and mental health effects, including respiratory depression, infections, and mental health disorders.
